root_idea.summary: The root centers on turning toward something and remaining attached to it without turning away, with a related sense of holding or being held back.
root_idea.development: The core sense develops into persistent devotion or attachment, remaining in a place, and detention. Other attested branches extend to approaching, surrounding, arranging elements together, and bending or curling.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed as the singular active-participle citation form.

senses.definition: To turn devotedly toward something and remain attached to it without turning away; in the Quran, to persist in the worship of idols.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَى for persistent attachment or devotion. The Quranic occurrence describes a group remaining devoted to its idols.

senses.definition: One who remains devotedly attached or intent upon something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses this of persistent devotional attachment, especially attachment to an object of worship; it may occur with عَلَى or as a predicate.

senses.definition: One who remains or resides in a place.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage, this is the place-oriented sense applied to those abiding at the sanctuary; it denotes residence or continued presence rather than necessarily the technical retreat of iʿtikāf.

senses.definition: One engaged in iʿtikāf: a person remaining in a mosque or place of worship for a prescribed devotional retreat.
senses.usage_conditions: This technical religious construction involves seclusion in the mosque and observance of the conditions of the devotional retreat.

senses.definition: Prevented from proceeding; detained or held back from reaching its appointed destination.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, used of the sacrificial offering prevented from reaching the place where it is to be offered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To approach or advance toward someone, or keep close to him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in a construction describing movement or approach toward a leader.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go around or circle something; to gather around it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexicon applies this to going around an object or gathering around a slain person, and figuratively to elements running around among strung beads.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go back or remain behind.
To make still or motionless; to detain, withhold, debar, or turn someone or something away from an intended object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the transitive causative use, including withholding someone from the object of a need.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put something into a sound, right, or proper state.
To keep components together or arrange them in an ordered formation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested of the elements of a necklace and of gems arranged among strung beads.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To curl, twist, contract, or gather hair into plaits.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived-form use describing hair made to cleave together or arranged in plaits.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To confine, restrain, withhold, or debar oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general reflexive use of self-restraint, distinct from the specifically religious retreat of iʿtikāf.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Crisp, curly, twisted, or contracted hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of the condition or texture of hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hair that has been combed and plaited.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal passive-participle use distinct from the Quranic sense of being detained.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place designated for iʿtikāf or devotional seclusion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the place in which a person performs iʿtikāf, such as a mosque or comparable place of worship.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Persistent attachment and devotion, including the Quranic idol-worship use.
Keeping or cleaving to a place is covered by the place-residence sense.
Approaching or advancing toward a leader.
Going around or gathering around an object.
Making still and detaining or turning away.
Continual attachment is covered by the Quranic devoted-attachment sense.
Technical devotional seclusion in a mosque or place of worship.
Description of crisp, curly, or contracted hair.
The unit states both persistent attachment to a thing and remaining or dwelling in a place.
Detained or withheld, explicitly including the Quranic use.
